mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.pug.selectPug */ PUG_ID as pugId, PJT_ID as pjtId, USER_ID as userId, GRP_ID as grpId FROM PROJECT_USER_GROUP WHERE PUG_ID = #{pugId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.pug.selectListCountPug */ COUNT(*) AS totcnt FROM PROJECT_USER_GROUP PUG JOIN USERS U ON PUG.USER_ID = U.USER_ID JOIN GROUPS G ON PUG.GRP_ID = G.GRP_ID WHERE PUG.PJT_ID = #{pjtId}
AND PUG.USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{scUserId}, '%')
AND U.NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{scUserName}, '%')
AND U.POSITION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{scUserPosition}, '%')
AND G.GRP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{scGrpName}, '%')
SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.pug.selectListGrp */ grp_id AS grpId, grp_name AS grpName FROM groups;

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.pug.selectListPugUser */ USER_ID AS userId, NAME AS name, EMAIL AS email, PHONE AS phone, POSITION AS position FROM ( SELECT U.USER_ID, U.NAME, U.EMAIL, U.PHONE, U.POSITION, CEIL((@ROWNUM := @ROWNUM + 1) / #{pageSize}) AS PAGE FROM (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) R, USERS U WHERE 1 = 1
AND U.USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{scUserId}, '%')
AND U.NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{scUserName}, '%')
ORDER BY U.USER_ID DESC ) A WHERE A.PAGE = #{pageIndex}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.pug.selectListCountPugUser */ COUNT(*) AS totcnt FROM USERS U WHERE 1 = 1
AND U.USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{scUserId}, '%')
AND U.NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{scUserName}, '%')
